actors.name: Kestrel Analytics support team members
actors.private_context: Each team member has their own perceptions about the upcoming reorg, but no one knows how it will actually affect their roles or workload. They have varying levels of trust in management and concerns about job security.

actors.name: Kestrel Analytics management
actors.private_context: Management has decided on a reorganization of the support team, with the goal of improving efficiency. They have not yet communicated the details to the team.

shared_context: Kestrel Analytics is a company with a support team that is about to undergo a reorganization. The reorg has been announced but not yet implemented. The team's morale is currently at a moderate level, with some uncertainty about the future.

starting_events.description: The reorg is scheduled to begin today, but no changes have been implemented yet.

resolution: Resolve YES only if, by the hard cutoff, the persistent event history shows that a majority of support team members have expressed (in observable communications or surveys) that morale is better than before the reorg. Otherwise resolve NO.
